sources.snippet: DeAOT Variant Overview The DeAOT model family consists of four size-based variants that provide different accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs. Each variant is defined by a configuration class that inherits from DefaultModelConfig and customizes specific architectural parameters. sources.title: deAPI - One API for Open Source Generative AI Models
sources.snippet: Which AI models are available through deAPI? deAPI supports popular open-source models including LTX Video, Qwen Edit, FLUX.1 Schnell, Z-Image Turbo, Kokoro, Whisper, BGE M3, and Nanonets OCR for various AI tasks. You can switch between models through a single endpoint. The model documentation is always updated with all supported models.
